rules.name: Combat Drills
rules.text: In step 3 of the Aftermath sequence you can pick up to 3 friendly Henchmen to train. Each of those fighters earns d6 bonus experience.

rules.name: Eager to Prove
rules.text: In step 6 of the aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 6, a Guild Recruit arrives at the Guild Barracks. You can recruit a Guild Recruit to your warband for 0 silver.

rules.name: Vintage Wines
rules.text: When this holding is first added to a warband roster, it has 2d6 bottles of vintage wine. Make a note on your warband roster. Each time you collect income from this holding, after rolling the dice, you can choose to sell 1 bottle of vintage wine. If you do so, reduce the count by 1 and re-roll one of the dice. You must accept the second result.

rules.name: Add to the Collection
rules.text: Each time your warband ransacks a holding, roll a dice. On a 4+ they find d3 bottles of vintage wine.

rules.name: Atonement for Sin
rules.text: If your warband lost the battle, in step 3 of the Aftermath sequence, make a Willpower test for each Witch Hunter and Priest in your warband. If they pass, they earn 5 bonus experience.

rules.name: Holy Relics
rules.text: Keep a tally of how many enemy Undead and Demon Champions and Leaders are taken down in battle against your warband. Each time the tally reaches a multiple of 10, the Witch Hunters' Guild rewards you with a holy relic, you can roll once on the Relic table.

rules.name: Sorcerous Study
rules.text: Each battle, before you determine prepared spells, you can pick 1 friendly Wizard in your warband. Instead of randomly determining the spell they have prepared from a Spell Lore, you can pick.

rules.name: Master the Arcane
rules.text: Each battle, keep a tally of how many spells each friendly Wizard critically casts. In step 3 of the aftermath sequence, each friendly Wizard earns 5 bonus experience for each spell they critically cast in the battle.

rules.name: Communion with the Saints
rules.text: Your warband can include 0-2 Guild Clerics. In addition, each battle, you can ignore the first miscast by a friendly Priest.

rules.name: The Apothecary's Potion
rules.text: In step six of the aftermath sequence, you receive 1 Healing Tonic.

rules.name: Raised Canine
rules.text: In step 6 of the aftermath sequence, you can roll a dice. On a 5+, you can recruit 1 Hunting Dog to your warband for 0 silver.

rules.name: Maintained Firearms
rules.text: Each battle, you can ignore the first misfire by a friendly fighter.

rules.name: Tend the Wounded
rules.text: If your warband includes a Plague Doctor, they can use their 'Sawbones' special rule twice each aftermath sequence.

rules.name: Heavy Infantry
rules.text: Up to 3 Henchman in your warband can be equipped with Full-plate Armour.
